_comment: Ground-truth surface boundaries for IoU scoring. Unlike gold.json (which pins an AREA), these pin the SHAPE, so a measurement can be scored on WHERE it looked and not only on how big the answer was. CLAUDE.md rule 4 exists because an agent once matched a gold area to 0.1% while outlining the WRONG region. Every entry needs a documented human source. polygon_pts are UNROTATED PDF points on the stated page, as returned by fitz get_drawings(); to raster-space: pt * page.rotation_matrix, then * S. The PDFs live under drawings/ and are gitignored, so consumers MUST skip visibly when the file is absent, never silently.

drawings/inderjit_p7/7_25195-MJM-00-00-D.source: Bluebeam area markup drawn by Aryan (U0BCUEBAAFQ) and posted to #fortel on 2026-08-26, Slack ts 1787736005.186649, Google Drive id 1UMauqocw-rCw5_gA_RhUcWD0GDbmqu5Q. The marked PDF differs from the unmarked sheet by exactly two vector paths: this polygon and its label box reading 'Unclassified area - 9,810.24 m2'. The marked PDF itself is kept OUT of drawings/ (at ~/fortel-ground-truth/) because the robustness corpus scans that tree and would otherwise measure the markup as if it were a client drawing; nothing here depends on the PDF, the vertices below are the artefact.
drawings/inderjit_p7/7_25195-MJM-00-00-D.corroboration: Independent shoelace over the extracted vertices gives 9810.12 m2, 0.001% from the markup's own label, which also confirms the sheet's 1:500 / k=0.176389 is read correctly. 94.6% of the sheet's red-tint (254,0,0) ink falls inside this polygon, so it is the right region and not an area coincidence. Inderjit quoted 9,857 m2 for the same yard on the 5 Aug call.
drawings/inderjit_p7/7_25195-MJM-00-00-D.note: The yard is drawn as RED DIAGONAL HATCHING, not a solid fill: 1 px strokes, median inter-stroke gap 26 px (2.29 m at 1:500), inking only 2.8% of the area they enclose. This is the reference case for hatch-aware detection.

092_25195-MJM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-S-2300-D2-P02-Mez.scale: ~1:200 (derived from the markup label, NOT read off the sheet)
092_25195-MJM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-S-2300-D2-P02-Mez.source: Reference markup posted by Aryan in #fortel 27 Aug 2026 01:06 IST, Drive id 1lSEIYvQnYSVmLsIU7GJi9B56iN2pfXBy, as 'it should be like' for the 092 Mezzanine sheet, which currently produces NO markups. Labels on it read 'Unclassified area - 1,202.40 m2', 'Cut-out 1 - 8.47 m2', 'Cut-out 2 - 9.61 m2'. Kept at ~/fortel-ground-truth/, OUT of drawings/, because the robustness corpus scans that tree.
092_25195-MJM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-S-2300-D2-P02-Mez.corroboration: geometry.measure_regions on these 19 vertices at k=0.070031 returns exactly 1202.40 m2, matching the markup label to +0.00%, which corroborates both the polygon and the derived scale. Driving Aryan's measure_regions_with_cutouts (53bd6b8) with cutouts of the labelled sizes returns net 1,184.30 against the label's 1,184.32.
092_25195-MJM-ZZ-ZZ-DR-S-2300-D2-P02-Mez.note: SOURCE SHEET NOT HELD LOCALLY — only this markup. Re-extract the unmarked sheet from the project-7 pack (Drive 17oWqg4aulX7dQUbtHtpEnSvfrsIsyZwR) before measuring; the markup overlay occludes what is beneath it, as proved on the MJM 9000 sheet.
